ops.title: Distinguish check identities when remembering missing failures
ops.description: Owner: rerun-reads-pending implementation owner. Evidence: plugins/long-running/lib/drive/github.py:72 reduces CheckRun.name and StatusContext.context to the same namespace; line 84 uses those names to detect absent failed checks. If CheckRun build fails and drops out during rerun while StatusContext build remains successful, the stored failed name is considered present and the verdict is pass. Next: retain stable context identities that distinguish type and source across reruns.

ops.text: A failed CheckRun absent during rerun remains pending when an unrelated passing StatusContext has the same display name.
Same-named checks from distinct workflows cannot satisfy each other's missing failure record.
A passing rerun of the original check can return pass.
